purpose: Connect authenticated checkout to pending-order creation and prove the full FT-007 runtime boundary.
success_outcome: A real browser/backend run proves one pending order, safe retry, reservation release after expiry, sanitized evidence, and no provider traffic.
anti_goals: No FT-009 provider or webhook implementation.
No complete FT-008 order lifecycle/Admin implementation.
No fake-server, direct database browser access, production data, or report-only success.

forbidden_scope: FT-009 payment-provider calls, webhook, or credentials
production data, secrets, direct browser database access

success_checks: Authenticated checkout sends cart reference and fresh idempotency key to order creation.
Browser displays pending-order handoff without claiming payment success.
Runtime proves one order/reservation set, same-order retry, stock conflict no-mutation, controlled expiry, and released reservations.
No provider request, client-authoritative tariff/items, PII, credentials, or production data appears in evidence.
Cleanup releases processes, ports, and synthetic fixtures before artifacts publish.
T3 markers and semantic-pass evidence are recorded.
evidence_required: Sanitized backend and browser acceptance reports.
Order/reservation mutation counters and duplicate identity evidence.
Expiry/release and cleanup/privacy evidence plus full T3 closure markers.

stop_conditions: Real authenticated browser/backend boundary cannot be exercised.
Evidence cannot prove no provider request and no duplicate order/reservation.
Cleanup or privacy guarantees are not reproducible.
Handoff requires changing FT-004 or FT-006 parser/auth/validation decisions.
